captions.detailed: A classic naval-style swivel deck cannon made of dark, matte iron. It features a tapered cylindrical barrel with a flared muzzle and a spherical cascabel knob at its breech, supported by a fork-shaped yoke on a vertical post. The post rests on a circular flanged base plate bolted with small hexagonal fasteners, allowing the yoke to rotate horizontally while the barrel pivots vertically on trunnion pins within the yoke slots.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a naval swivel deck cannon using CadQuery. The design should include a vertical post with a bolted flanged base, a rotatable fork-style yoke, and an elevating tapered barrel with a flared muzzle and cascabel knob.
captions.factory: The base post is constructed using a cylinder for the main column, a thin cylinder for the base flange, and a pattern of small cylinders for the mounting bolts. The yoke is constructed by combining a central vertical pin (cylinder) with a rectangular block, which is hollowed out and slotted using boolean subtractions to form the fork arms. The tapered barrel is modeled by lofting or combining concentric cylinders of varying diameters, adding a sphere at the breech for the cascabel, and attaching a horizontal cylinder through the center of gravity to represent the trunnion pins.
